evidence_ref: extract.rs suppresses generic owner surface/image then calls divider_render_commands; owner_text_prewarm.rs suppresses text; ui/tests/render_divider.rs proves fractional geometry, horizontal/vertical variants and invalid override rejection.
segments.rs and tabs.rs call quad_command/text_command with retained owner node and local frames; extract.rs fills text artifacts after collecting generated commands.

segmented_controls.rs classifies component before SegmentedVisual/State; segments.rs obtains segmented_options and selected_segment_value then compares option_is_selected; style.rs uses first_rgba/metrics/line_height.

segmented_controls.rs::segmented_control_render_commands resolves state once; style.rs separates tab active from surface_hot, segments.rs compares per-option value itself; ui/tests/render_segmented_controls.rs focused neutral/loading state tests.

segments.rs consumes selected_surface/option_text_color/segmented_background/border; tabs.rs consumes tab_background/tab_text_color; ui/tests/render_segmented_controls.rs verifies focus neutral until hovered and valid style priority.
checkbox.rs/radio.rs use leading_mark_rect,label_rect_after_mark,centered_square; toggle.rs uses label/track/thumb rect; surface input dispatch never treats these draw frames as separate node IDs.

selection_controls.rs routes Checkbox/Radio/Toggle/Switch; state.rs uses selection_painter_family; checkbox.rs/radio.rs/toggle.rs obtain labels; style.rs consumes validated color/metric/line_height helpers.

selection_controls.rs resolves once before checkbox/radio/toggle; geometry.rs uses active to choose thumb endpoint; style.rs applies unavailable/active/focus_border independently; render_selection_controls.rs loading,checked+hover,pressed border tests.
checkbox.rs/radio.rs/toggle.rs call family role selectors; UiRenderPainterStateSource folds static/runtime state; render_selection_controls.rs valid overrides and focus neutral until hovered tests.

extract.rs calls skeleton_render_commands and suppresses generic surface/image; owner_text_prewarm.rs suppresses skeleton text; render function emits one static quad, no scheduler/timer caller; circular radius derives short edge.

render/sliders.rs::slider_render_commands calls commands::quad_command for track/fill/thumb and text_command for label; SliderRenderState/SliderVisual and sliders/state_colors.rs produce caller data; embedded optimization test verifies exact CSS color encoding.
